request.title: Geronimo! Cannonball!
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: the bottom of a sewer shaft beneath Fireholm Skyport, seen from the floor looking up at a round open hatch full of daylight. Fiddle: a small green-skinned goblin ranger with large pointed ears, leather armour hung with clover charms and dice, a quiver of arrows on his back; he lies flat on his back in the filthy water, groaning. Gideon: a slight fairy necromancer with large translucent insect wings, pointed ears, messy dark hair and dark ragged clothing; he has dived straight down the hole and landed sprawled on top of Fiddle, grinning. D.E.R.E.K. (also called Chadron): a humanoid golden construct with a smooth metal face, a single large glowing blue eye and full red lips, wearing hooded red-and-orange robes decorated with clockwork and clock-face motifs; he descends gracefully through the shaft of light, hovering, robes floating, perfectly clean, refusing to touch the floor. Above them all, framed in the hatch, Ulrick: a broad-shouldered human paladin with short swept-back dark brown hair and a full dark beard, wearing heavy dark plate armour with bronze-orange pauldrons and a long white cloth tabard over the armour is mid-leap, knees tucked into a cannonball, armour and all, about to land on the pile. Slapstick energy, dynamic vertical composition, dramatic light from above.
